1.explanation: The code creates two icon-only buttons using the Carbon Design System's Button component. Each button has a tooltip that appears on focus or hover. The first button's tooltip appears when it is focused (e.g., by clicking or tabbing to it), and the second button's tooltip appears when it is hovered over. This setup reproduces the issue where both tooltips are visible and overlap when the user interacts with both buttons in sequence.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves two icon-only buttons placed next to each other. When one button is clicked, its tooltip appears. If the user then hovers over the second button, its tooltip also appears, causing both tooltips to be visible and overlap each other. This is problematic as it creates a cluttered UI and can confuse users.
